mm_preview_feature_desc: Shows the available servers and map pool directly in the match-accept popup.
mm_preview_mode_desc: What to display: servers only, maps only, or both.
matchmaking_desc: Stats and tools for the matchmaking queue: server ping and per-map win rates.
server_ping_desc: Shows your live ping to each server in the matchmaking server list.
ping_tip: Approximate ping. It is measured from the browser, so your ping in the game may differ.
auto_accept_desc: Automatically presses the accept button when a match is ready. You can cancel during the countdown.
auto_accept_delay_desc: How many seconds to wait before pressing accept.
auto_accept_not_found: Accept button not found, press it manually
map_stats_desc: Shows your party's win rate and average kills for each map in the pool.
mm_no_map_games: No matches on this map in the selected range
mm_no_map_games_n: No games on this map in the last {0} matches
advanced_match_history_desc: Provides advanced match history features including ELO tracking, colored stats, and detailed match popups.
match_counter_desc: Displays match numbers for every 30th match.
kda_color_desc: Colors KDA by k/d ratio. (k/d ≥ 1 = green)
kr_desc: Kills per round ratio. Average number of kills per round played.
fcr_desc: FCR - player's contribution share in the team based on performance. Sum of FCR for all 5 team players = 100%. Ideal is when all 5 players performed at 20%.
avgelo_desc: Displays the average Elo of your team and the enemy team.
rounded_stats_desc: Round ADR, K/D and K/R values to one decimal place.
new_elo_rankings_desc: Replaces standard Faceit levels with new ranking icons that reflect your actual skill level based on elo points.
colored_level_digits_desc: Paints the number inside the level icon with the level colour instead of white. The old look of the icons.
new_levels_desc: A 20-level scale instead of ten, with our own icons and colours. Turn it off and levels stay FACEIT-native, capped at ten.
sidebar_elo_desc: Draws level, elo and progress around your avatar in the right sidebar. Below it: elo gained this session and how much is left to the top 1000.
sidebar_elo_menu_desc: Draws level, elo and progress at your avatar in the right sidebar and in the profile menu. Below the avatar: session elo and how far it is to the top 1000.
friends_levels_desc: Shows elo and level for friends in the Social panel and on the friends page.
invite_levels_desc: Shows elo and level for every player in the Invite to party list.
advanced_matchroom_desc: Advanced matchroom features including team and player map winrate statistics.
team_map_winrate_desc: Displays a table with map statistics (winrate, games, avg kills) for each team.
player_map_winrate_desc: Displays personal map statistics for each player in their profile card.
show_team_elo_desc: Shows teams' average ELO above the rosters in the matchroom header.
matchroom_ping_desc: Shows your ping to each server in the matchroom, including the veto list.
auto_copy_ip_desc: Copies the connect command for the match server to your clipboard as soon as the server is ready.
auto_copy_ip_no_access: Copying the connect command needs access to the clipboard
player_notes_desc: Lets you leave a short note on a player in the matchroom and in the captain pick. Notes are stored only in your browser.
player_notes_profile_desc: Also show the note on the player profile page, under the nickname.
note_color_desc: The color a new note gets when it is created. Notes you already saved keep their own color.
team_view_mode_desc: Choose how team map stats are shown: full table, old table, or a radar chart over the map pool.
player_view_mode_desc: Choose how each player's map stats are shown: full table, old table, or a radar chart.
player_no_5v5: No 5v5 matches in the last {0} games
match_amount_desc: Number of recent matches to analyze for your party's statistics.
quick_position_setup_desc: Allows sending a specific message on a particular map when it's selected or picked. You can configure custom messages for each CS2 map.
qps_panel_setting_desc: Shows the fast call card above the team chat input. Turn it off to keep sending without the card.
qps_tooltip: Fast call. Sends your message to the team chat once the map is picked. Set it up in the extension menu.
qps_has_line: has a message for this map
qps_limit_last: The last profile cannot be deleted
qps_message_limit: No more than {0} characters in the message
qps_name_limit: No more than {0} characters in the profile name
integrations_desc: Adds partner integrations that may include promotional content. These integrations help the project grow and stay free for everyone.
appearance_desc: Controls what the extension puts on FACEIT pages besides the statistics themselves.
brand_logo_desc: Shows the Forecast mark on the panels the extension adds. Player badges are not affected.
sidebar_button_desc: The button on the FACEIT sidebar that opens the extension menu. With it off the menu is only available from the browser toolbar.

player_plate_desc: A stats line under each player card in the matchroom, over the selected match window. Recent form is always shown; the rest of the columns are chosen here.
player_country_desc: A country flag tab above each player card in the matchroom.
player_encounters_desc: How many times you have already played with or against this player, based on your last 100 matches.
veto_stats_desc: Win rate and number of games for both teams on each map card during the veto.
telemetry_desc: Controls what anonymous usage data the extension sends. Everything here is optional and can be turned off at any time.
telemetry_usage_desc: Reports how many requests go to FACEIT and how many of them are rejected, and which features are in use. Request speed is tuned by this, and so is the decision about what to improve next. No nickname, match IDs or note text is ever sent.
telemetry_selectors_desc: Reports whether the extension still finds the page elements it needs. This is how a change in the FACEIT layout is spotted and fixed before anyone has to report it.
